DISCOVER THE CITY OF WONDERS

Explore Dubai's Most Celebrated Landmarks at Your Own Pace

Dubai is a metropolis where centuries-old wind towers and spice-scented souks coexist harmoniously with world-record skyscrapers and artificial island marvels. Rather than being confined to rigid schedules on crowded tourist buses, our private Dubai City Tour gives you a dedicated luxury vehicle, a knowledgeable local driver-guide, and the freedom to spend as much time as you like at each iconic landmark.

From the vibrant alleys of the Gold & Spice Souks in Deira to the sail-shaped silhouette of the Burj Al Arab and the opulent villas of Palm Jumeirah, this tour covers the complete spectrum of Dubai's history, culture, and ultra-modern ambition.

Iconic Stops Included in Your Sightseeing Itinerary

🕌 Al Fahidi Heritage & Dubai Creek

Stroll through historic coral-stone alleyways, cross the creek on a traditional motorized Abra, and shop gold and exotic spices.

⛵ Burj Al Arab & Jumeirah Beach

Snap postcard photos with the world's only self-proclaimed 7-star luxury hotel framing the azure Persian Gulf waters.

🌴 Palm Jumeirah & Atlantis

Drive along the trunk and outer crescent of the engineering marvel Palm Jumeirah, pausing for photos at Atlantis The Palm and The Royal.

🏙️ Dubai Marina & JBR

Marvel at the world's highest density of residential skyscrapers, luxury superyachts, and the Ain Dubai observation wheel.

🖼️ Dubai Frame & Museum of the Future

Capture the architectural brilliance of the Museum of the Future's Arabic calligraphy torus and the world's biggest photo frame.

✨ Burj Khalifa & Downtown Dubai

Conclude at Dubai Mall, where you can pair your city tour with the spectacular Burj Khalifa Lake Ride on Burj Lake.

Pair Your City Tour with Desert Adventures & Water Experiences

A city tour shows you Dubai's architectural triumphs, but the true spirit of the UAE lies in its natural contrasts. Phoenix Tours makes it effortless to bundle your urban sightseeing with our top-rated adventures:

  • Evening Desert Safari & BBQ Dinner: After exploring the city by day, head into the Lahbab red dunes for thrilling 4x4 dune bashing, camel rides, and live entertainment at our Dubai Desert Safari.
  • Self-Drive Dune Thrills: Add high-speed sand action to your holiday by renting automatic Quad Bikes in Dubai from AED 150 or high-performance turbocharged Can-Am Dune Buggies.
  • Downtown Lake Cruise: Finish your city excursion on the tranquil waters of Burj Lake with front-row seats to the fountain show on the Burj Khalifa Lake Ride.
  • Cross-Emirate Sightseeing: Continue your cultural discovery by booking our private day tour to the UAE capital on the Abu Dhabi City Tour from Dubai.

Frequently Asked Questions

What type of vehicle is provided for the tour?

We provide modern, clean, fully air-conditioned vehicles such as Toyota Previa, Innova, or Land Cruisers for up to 6 guests, and high-roof luxury vans for larger groups.

Are admission tickets included in the price?

The base tour includes private chauffeur service, vehicle fuel, parking, and traditional creek Abra boat crossing. Entrance tickets to inside venues (such as the Burj Khalifa At The Top observatory, Museum of the Future, or Dubai Frame) can be added upon request on WhatsApp.

Can we visit Abu Dhabi on the same day?

Abu Dhabi is approximately 140 km from Dubai, so we recommend dedicating a separate day for the capital. View our comprehensive Abu Dhabi City Tour from Dubai to visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Louvre Museum.
